technical.summary: Long-term structure bullish but short-term momentum weak; oversold conditions present but lack confirmation signals and price remains below key moving averages.

fundamental.summary: NI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 70 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money conviction to support a trade.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (395.2) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve provides limited offset; utilities defensive but macro stress environment unfavourable for equity positioning.
